system.description:
You coat your hands in medical chakra designed to sap the life force of anyone you touch. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature, you gain temporary hit points equal to the damage [Unarmed Damage] dealt.

Monstrous Burst. For the duration, your [Unarmed Damage] can be necrotic. When you make an unarmed attack, If you roll a 5 or 6, on your [Unarmed Damage] die, you add an additional 1d6 to the damage. You can repeat this effect up to 4 times, each turn.

Healers Touch. For the duration, when you deal [Unarmed Damage], you can select one willing creature within 10 feet of you, and they gain temporary hit points equal to the [Unarmed Damage] dealt.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast as a B-Rank or higher, you also regain Hit Points equal to the [Unarmed Damage] dealt. If cast as an S-Rank, you can gain temporary hit points twice per turn. Temporary hit points gained this way, stacks with itself.
